title: 摩根大通戴蒙：AI资本开支或达万亿，真正的风险是资本需求与政府支出
speaker: Jamie Dimon

segments.en: So in layering that on top of the forecast around a cap expense for AI, 700 billion this year, potentially a trillion next year, is the view from your team, what is the biggest, what is the potential biggest risk to that forecast, is it a physical buildout, is it the monetization, is it the cost of capital, is it something else?
segments.zh: 在AI资本开支今年7000亿、明年可能达万亿的预测之上，你们团队认为最大风险是什么？是实体建设、变现、资本成本，还是别的？

segments.en: Well, I think you mentioned, it's all those things, you know, and we went through the internet, in total pays off, but there'll be better models, better semi-conductors, there'll be changing schedules.
segments.zh: 你提到的这些因素都存在，我们经历过互联网，总体是值得的，但会有更好的模型、更好的半导体，时间表也会变化。

segments.en: There'll be lawsuits about billions of data centers, most of them will get built, they'll probably be built where people want them, as opposed to where people don't want them, they'll be used, AI itself, I think, creates a lot of value, and so I'm not really worried about it.
segments.zh: 会有关于数十亿数据中心的诉讼，多数会建成，可能建在人们欢迎的地方而非反对的地方，AI本身创造很多价值，我并不太担心。

segments.en: But you do point out, it is a lot of additional barn, so there's normal cap expense barn, I don't know if the barn's a trillion, because it's like the commitments, but there's a lot of barn, and then the government's barn's two trillion dollars again.
segments.zh: 但你指出，确实有大量额外支出，正常资本开支之外，我不确定是否达万亿，因为那像承诺，但支出很大，政府那边又是两万亿美元。

segments.en: And this is a global phenomenon, it's not just in the United States, and yeah, there's a supply and demand of capital, if you thought there was a savings glut years ago, now there's not.
segments.zh: 这是全球现象，不只在美国，资本的供需在变化，几年前你如果认为有储蓄过剩，现在没有了。

segments.en: And you know, but it could be a good thing, if rates are going up because there's a demand for capital, and the capital you'd productively, the problem apart is the government, it's consumption, that's a whole different thing, so, and then of course government spending can drive inflation so there could be a flip side of how this plays out.
segments.zh: 这可能是好事，如果利率上升是因为资本需求，且资本被有效使用，问题在于政府支出是消费性的，那是另一回事，政府支出可能推升通胀，所以结果可能有另一面。
